newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW says targeting higher earnings power.
newsitem.headline: BMW says targeting higher earnings power.

text.p: MUNICH, Germany, March 25 - German luxury car-maker Bayerische Motoren Werke (BMW) said on Tuesday it is targeting higher productivity and profits this year.
"The BMW group will make the most of its opportunities to continue to increase its productivity and strengthen its earning power," the company said in its annual financial report.
BMW sales in 1996 climbed 13.3 percent to 52 million marks ($30.8 million), boosting profits 18.5 percent to 820 million marks.
The company said it expected demand to grow slowly in Europe this year and that markets in North America as well as Japan would stagnate.
"After strong growth in 1996, the trend in BMW car sales should stabilise at a high level."
